text.description_html:
Modern Stainless Steel Barn Door Handle and Flush Pull Set

This Modern Pull and Flush Door Handle Set comes packaged with everything you'll need for your barn door. The flush pull is 5-5/16 inches tall. It only has a 1/16 inch projection so it will fit even where there is little space between the barn door and the wall. It has a spring-loaded finger cutout cover that depresses to reveal the inner lip. When not in use, the flush appearance is truly beautiful, a perfect take on ultra-modern design. The handle is 24 inches long, and the perfect size for standard barn door sizes. Its modern look will be sure to enhance any setting with a contemporary design aesthetic.

Also Available Matching Stainless Steel Barn Door Track Kit

Specifications for the 24 Inch Handle and Flush Pull Set for Modern Barn Doors:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Handle Total Length: 24" (610 mm)
  • Handle Mounting Centers: 14-3/8" (365 mm) C/C
  • Handle Projection: 3-3/16" (81 mm)
  • Handle Diameter: 1-1/8" (29 mm) Square
  • Flush Pull Total Height: 5-5/16" (135mm)
  • Flush Pull Total Width: 2-3/16" (55 mm)
  • Flush Pull Total Depth: 3/4" (19 mm)
  • Flush Pull Mounting Hole Depth: 21/32" (17 mm)
  • Flush Pull Projection: 1/16" (2 mm)
  • Flush Pull Finger Opening Height: 3-15/16" (100 mm)
  • Flush Pull Finger Opening Width: 1" (25 mm)
  • Flush Pull Door Cutout Opening Height: 4-15/16" (125 mm)
  • Flush Pull Door Cutout Opening Width: 1-13/16" (46 mm)
  • Flush Pull Lip: 5/16" (8 mm)

About Mounting: The Flush Pull is pressure mounted into the door so screws are not needed. The Door Handle is Surface Mounted, so the pull screws to the face of the door.

Packaged as a complete set with (1) flush pull, (1) surface mount door pull, and all the ncessary mounting hardware.
